entities.name: Louis-Marie Baudouin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis-Marie Baudouin was a French Roman Catholic priest who was the founder of the Sons of Mary Immaculate and the Ursulines of Jesus. Pope Benedict XVI proclaimed him as venerable on 20 December 2012.
